purpose: Compare random-window, recording-disjoint and participant-disjoint evaluation using exactly the same fixed learner and hyperparameters under the corrected eight-channel parser.

data.label_mapping: raw levels 0-1 = class 0; raw levels 2-3 = class 1
data.stroop_exclusion: S14 and S15 are excluded because their high-level files are byte-identical and provenance cannot be resolved.

recording_disjoint.validation_composition: one class-0 recording and one class-1 recording

evaluation.split_repeats: averaged within participant and never treated as independent inferential samples
evaluation.paired_test: two-sided Wilcoxon with Pratt zero handling, approximate method and no continuity correction
evaluation.multiple_comparisons: six paired split comparisons form one post-hoc BH family

interpretation.random_vs_recording: The most direct estimate of same-recording near-duplicate contamination because model, participant scope and learner are matched.
interpretation.participant_disjoint: Also changes the training population and introduces participant domain shift; its difference from recording-disjoint is not attributed solely to leakage.
prohibited_claims: The audit is preregistered or confirmatory.
Participant-disjoint minus recording-disjoint isolates only leakage.
